github.title: GitHub App
github.description: Configure GitHub App OAuth credentials for sign-in, registration, and profile linking.
github.error.title: Could not load GitHub settings
github.form.section_hint: Use your GitHub App OAuth credentials. Login and registration can be enabled independently; global registration must also be on.
github.form.callback_hint: Set this callback URL in your GitHub App: {{url}}
github.form.enabled_hint: Requires Client ID and Client Secret.
github.form.register_enabled_hint: Also requires global registration to be enabled under Auth settings.
github.form.client_id_hint: OAuth client ID from the GitHub App.
github.form.client_secret_hint: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
github.form.private_key_hint: Stored encrypted for future GitHub API use. Leave blank to keep the current key.
google.title: Google
google.description: Configure Google OAuth for sign-in and registration.
google.error.title: Could not load Google settings
google.form.section_hint: Create OAuth credentials in Google Cloud Console. Redirect URI must end with /api/auth/callback/google.
google.form.login_enabled_hint: Requires Client ID and Client Secret.
google.form.register_enabled_hint: Also requires global registration under Auth settings.
google.form.client_secret_hint: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
facebook.title: Facebook
facebook.description: Configure Facebook Login for sign-in and registration.
facebook.error.title: Could not load Facebook settings
facebook.form.section_hint: Production apps cannot use localhost — use a Facebook development app for local callbacks.
facebook.form.login_enabled_hint: Requires App ID (Client ID) and App Secret.
facebook.form.register_enabled_hint: Also requires global registration under Auth settings.
facebook.form.client_id_hint: Facebook App ID used as OAuth client ID.
facebook.form.client_secret_hint: Leave blank to keep the current secret.
apple.title: Apple
apple.description: Configure Sign in with Apple. Upload the .p8 signing key and the client secret is generated automatically.
apple.error.title: Could not load Apple settings
apple.form.section_hint: Apple requires HTTPS (including local). Use a Services ID as Client ID. Upload the signing key below; a pasted client secret JWT is only a fallback.
apple.form.login_enabled_hint: Requires the Services ID and a signing key (or a client secret JWT).
apple.form.register_enabled_hint: Also requires global registration under Auth settings.
apple.form.client_secret_hint: Only needed without a signing key. Apple JWTs expire after at most 6 months. Leave blank to keep the current one.
apple.form.client_secret_generated_hint: Not needed: the client secret is generated from the signing key. A pasted JWT is ignored while a key is configured.
apple.form.signing_key_hint: Sign in with Apple key from Apple Developer → Keys. Used for the web client secret, native sign-in and token revocation. Stored encrypted.
apple.form.team_id_hint: 10 characters, shown at the top right of Apple Developer → Membership.
apple.form.key_id_hint: 10 characters. It is in the file name AuthKey_<KEYID>.p8 and is filled in when you pick the file.
apple.form.private_key_hint: Choose the AuthKey_<KEYID>.p8 file downloaded from Apple. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
apple.form.private_key_replace_hint: A key is stored. Choose a new .p8 file to replace it.
apple.form.private_key_invalid: This is not a valid .p8 key file.
description: Configure external social login and OAuth identity providers.
connect_description: Choose the provider and enter your organization's own account details.
disable_description: No new work starts through this account; pending work is still verified.
edit_description: Update the name, the mode or the keys.
empty_description: Connect your SMS, WhatsApp, e-mail or payment provider account.
fields.sandbox_hint: When off, the provider does real work (live mode).
jobs.detail_description: Every call made to the provider and its result.
jobs.empty_description: Calls to providers and incoming notifications show up here.
jobs.needs_verification_note: The outcome is unknown: the provider may have done the work. "Retry" asks for the status first and only sends again when the provider confirms the work was not done.
jobs.title: Jobs — {{account}}
jobs.toast.already_done: The provider confirmed the work is done; nothing was sent again.
jobs.toast.busy: The job is being processed; try again shortly.
jobs.toast.in_progress: The work is still in progress at the provider; nothing was sent again.
jobs.toast.resubmitted: The provider confirmed the work was not done; it was sent again.
jobs.toast.unverified: The provider could not confirm the state; nothing was sent again. Check the provider's panel.
provider_hints.log: Development only: messages are not sent, they are written masked to the server log.
provider_hints.testpay: Development only: no real money is charged; the payment page shows Pay / Decline buttons. The secret key signs the notifications.
provider_hints.paytr: Find these in the PayTR merchant panel under Support & Setup > Integration information. Set the notification URL to https://<your domain>/api/v1/public/payments/paytr/notify.
rotate_hint: Leave empty to keep the current key.
secrets_note: Once saved, keys are only shown masked.
title: Integrations
page_description: Your organization's own provider accounts. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
provider_hints.meta: Enter the Phone number ID of your WhatsApp number on Meta Business, a permanent access token (system user), the App secret and a verify token of your choice. For the confirmation request, have Meta approve a template with three quick reply buttons (I will come, Cancel, Change); an empty template name uses randevu_teyit. After saving, edit the account to see its webhook address.
webhook.label: Webhook address
webhook.hint: Enter this address and the verify token in your Meta app under WhatsApp > Configuration and subscribe to the "messages" field. Delivery reports and the customer's button replies arrive here.
